description: Metadata and optional downloader only. No raw archives, normalized price panels or price-path files are included here.
dataset_terms_observed: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, version 1.0 dated 2026-08-26; distinct from repository code MIT licence.
provenance_note: PROVENANCE.json preserves original acquisition paths as historical records; re-download paths are chosen with --output-dir. URLs, requests, timestamps, checksum matches and hashes remain unchanged.
analysis_scope: Independent-venue spot-price sensitivity, not exact Hyperliquid oracle prices; both actual and frozen positions are revalued while the input cash ledger is retained.
release_policy: Exclude archives and normalized prices from public release. Review licence terms for any redistribution or derivative work.
